source.section: 10.12.3 Dealing with missing outcome data from individual participants

scope: General rationale and limitations of extreme-case missing-outcome sensitivity analyses; the clinical context is not an agent benchmark.
limitations: Bounds describe hypothetical binary assignments, not observed outcomes or predicted reruns.
No confidence interval, statistical test, causal effect or superiority claim is derived.
Invalid-scope attempts need not have meaningful binary outcomes without correcting the experiment.
